MSG-DUCT.name: MSG + SPICE flow duct
MSG-DUCT.desc: Fan-driven flow duct built for SPICE, operated inside the Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG).

CIR-ACME.name: CIR + ACME modular inserts
CIR-ACME.desc: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments hardware in the Combustion Integrated Rack.

CIR-MDCA.name: CIR + MDCA
CIR-MDCA.desc: Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus in the Combustion Integrated Rack.

CYGNUS.name: Saffire module in Cygnus
CYGNUS.desc: Large flow-duct experiment flown in the Cygnus cargo vehicle after it leaves the ISS.

MSG-SAME.name: MSG + SAME smoke hardware
MSG-SAME.desc: Comparative Soot Diagnostic heritage hardware with smoke detectors and particle counters.

HANDHELD.name: Hand-held aerosol counters
HANDHELD.desc: Commercial particle counters (TSI P-Trak, DustTrak) operated in the ISS cabin.

GROUND.name: Ground / computational
GROUND.desc: Ground-based modeling or analysis of flight data.
